spans.text: The Idol Choir members are dedicated to chronicling historic events, acting as witnesses to large political events, and are often encouraged to train as performers as well as clerics. This clergy is collectively known as “the Bard’s Beloved”, or just “Bard Beloved”. Moreso than anyone who serves the knights, they are taught tolerance and to shelter those who suffer unwarranted discrimination, and are cautious of repeating the mistakes of the past. Members of the Idol Choir are very rarely sent out alone, and can almost always be found assigned in pairs.
